Hi @ida, LEDGERLIB-104 is ready for review. The `allocate_cents` function implements the largest-remainder method with proper handling for negative totals (refunds). Both unit and acceptance tests are green. The key insight was that tie-breaking depends on the sign of the total: earlier indices win for positive totals, later indices win for negative totals (so earlier indices stay at the floor value). Please let me know if you have any questions!
